_about: QUALITATIVE scouting notes (not used for ranking). Gathered by web search on 2026-11-15 from public reporting; each note cites its source. Used only to explain results, flag risks or break labelled near-ties (hard rule 3). Reports conflict in places; conflicts are stated. Unverified claims are marked.

_general.note: IPL 2027 auction on 16 December 2026 in Goa. Retention lists were due mid-November 2026: reports differ on 15 vs 17 November. No 2027 retention list was published at the time of writing, so every 'under contract' player is only available if released.
_general.source: Wikipedia, List of 2027 IPL personnel changes (rev 1385657353); CricTracker; NewsBytes

_general.note: Trades confirmed before the deadline: Pant (LSG->DC), Kuldeep Yadav (DC->LSG), T Natarajan (DC->SRH), Zeeshan Ansari (SRH->DC), Livingstone and Jack Edwards (SRH->CSK), Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis (CSK->SRH), Hardik Pandya (MI->PBKS), Arshdeep Singh (PBKS->MI), Harshal Patel (SRH->GT, 15 Nov). Ajinkya Rahane retired on 30 July 2026.
_general.source: Wikipedia, List of 2027 IPL personnel changes

Jasprit Bumrah.note: Left-knee impact injury while fielding (July 2026 ODI v England); ruled out of the Sri Lanka Tests. Rested from the NZ T20Is/ODIs in Oct-Nov 2026 and lined up for the NZ Tests from 19 Nov. Long-standing workload management. No IPL-specific concern reported.

Sunil Narine.note: Aged 38 by IPL 2027. Retained by KKR for 2026 (Rs 12 cr) when Russell was released; named among possible KKR captains after Rahane's retirement. No 2027 retention confirmation found.

Rashid Khan.note: Lower-back problems since 2023 and surgery after the 2023 World Cup; says he rushed back too early. Doctor advised limiting Test cricket (April 2026). White-ball workload continued: 15 wickets in 11 IPL 2026 matches reported.

Varun Chakravarthy.note: Several 2026 setbacks: hand injury (April), left-foot injury in IPL 2026 (seen with crutch and brace in May; missed matches), then reported finger fractures and a side strain in India T20Is. Reports conflict on dates. Durability is the main risk.

Wanindu Hasaranga.note: Left hamstring injury at the T20 World Cup (Feb 2026); ruled out of the whole of IPL 2026 and replaced by George Linde (10 April 2026). His IPL 2026 data is therefore missing, not poor.

Matheesha Pathirana.note: Calf injury at the T20 World Cup (Feb 2026), then a hamstring injury after 8 balls in his only IPL 2026 match for KKR; hamstring surgery in France on 16 June 2026. Return date not found. High injury risk.
Matheesha Pathirana.source: ICC; Outlook India; manager's statement reported in Sri Lankan media

Mujeeb Ur Rahman.note: Not on a 2026 IPL roster (open market). Left SA20 2026 early; reason not reported, so injury not confirmed.

Tim David.note: Grade-two right hamstring strain in the BBL (Dec 2025), returned for the T20 World Cup; an earlier hamstring injury cost him nearly two months of IPL 2025. Recurring hamstring issue.

Phil Salt.note: Left-finger injury 18 April 2026, about a month out; reported fit again before the IPL 2026 final.

Heinrich Klaasen.note: Retired from international cricket (June 2025) and ruled out a comeback (2026), but continues in franchise cricket; 624 runs at SR 160 reported for IPL 2026. Age 35 in 2027.

Nicholas Pooran.note: Retired from international cricket in June 2025; IPL 2026 described as a poor season by his own account (LSG eliminated first). Model already reflects his 2026 balls.

Suryakumar Yadav.note: Long T20I slump in 2025, rebound in Jan 2026 (82 off 37 v NZ); sports-hernia surgery in 2025; wrist-injury rumours (May 2026) denied. Poor IPL 2026 form reported. One unconfirmed report says India won the 2026 T20 World Cup under his captaincy.

Finn Allen.note: Dropped by KKR for form in April 2026 (no injury), then 93 off 35 v GT on 17 May. Very high strike rate, volatile output.
